scope: Static review of local-first Clarion backend routes, upload handling, configuration, and concurrency controls
classification: RESEARCH LOCAL USE ONLY; NOT READY FOR PUBLIC OR MULTI-USER EXPOSURE

authentication_authorization.detail: No auth/authz middleware or route dependencies were found.

network_binding.detail: The main entry point binds 0.0.0.0; unauthenticated endpoints must remain on a trusted network.

cors.detail: Default origins are local; methods and headers are wildcard; credentials are disabled.

upload_limits.detail: Configured 50 MB cap is read in bounded chunks and rejects after limit+1 bytes; PDF signature and DOCX archive structure are checked.

filename_path_handling.detail: Filename is metadata; no user filename path construction was observed in the reviewed upload flow.

resource_controls.detail: Background concurrency semaphore defaults to 3; no API rate limit found.

diagnostic_disclosure.detail: Unauthenticated runtime/storage diagnostic routes can reveal environment paths.

decision: Do not treat the application as production-ready or expose it publicly until authentication, authorization, rate limiting, binding policy, and diagnostic disclosure are addressed.
evidence_scope: Code inspection only; no penetration test or public deployment test was performed.
